scientific_integrity: Elementary infinite-dimensional analytic proof; numerical experiments are not proof. Same-model correctness, originality and value checks only; independent verification not performed.
scientific_limitations: One exceptional first weight only; 1<p<infinity, real and complex ell_p; supercritical exact radii not computed; p=2 reproduces prior Hilbert result. Novelty is limited by unindexed and incompletely inspected historical literature.
title: Sharp numerical-radius and attainment thresholds for one-edge perturbations of \(\ell_p\) shifts
